_about: The regions of the world (docs/world/WORLD_SPINE.md). Written by tools/world/regions_ledger.py: edit REGIONS there.

regions.name: The Lantern Vale
regions.line: Where the lanterns still hold the mist back.

regions.name: The Marches
regions.line: The road, and the keeps that were raised to guard it.

regions.name: The Greenreach
regions.line: Old forest. It was here before the names were.

regions.name: The Stonemarch
regions.line: The mountains, and the halls the dwarves dug too deep to keep.

regions.name: The Frostmarch
regions.line: The north, where the mist freezes and does not lift.

regions.name: The Sunder Sea
regions.line: The lake that was the Hollow ran out to here, and took the coast with it.

regions.name: The Deep Road
regions.line: The long way under the world, from the lost dwarf-holds to the city of the dead.

regions.name: The Sundered Reach
regions.line: East, toward the Throne. Every mile of it was a kingdom once.

regions.name: The Places Beyond
regions.line: Not on any road: reached by a door, a death or a bargain.
